# From Seed to Shelter

> A small, part-time initiative, founded in 2025, tackling food and nutrition challenges facing displaced people. We look for vulnerabilities that bigger organisations overlook and work with local organisations and communities to address them. We publish what we learn, including the limitations.

Current work: microgreens in Greece, from a community farm at a community centre outside Zervou refugee camp on Samos (2025) to free seeds and videos for growing at home (2026), with an open invitation to other NGOs to pilot it; and research in progress on food insecurity among newly arrived refugees in Nakivale, Kyaka II and Rwamwanja settlements in south-western Uganda, with site visits planned for December 2026.

Everything we publish is free to use, adapt and republish. Contact: hello [at] fromseedtoshelter [dot] com

## Pages

- [Home](https://fromseedtoshelter.com/): who we are, how we work, and our current projects
- [Our work](https://fromseedtoshelter.com/work.html): an overview of our projects in Greece and Uganda
- [Microgreens in Greece](https://fromseedtoshelter.com/greece.html): the project from the 2025 Samos farm (results and limitations) to growing at home and the free-seed stall
- [Low-cost homegrown microgreens intervention, an invitation to pilot](https://fromseedtoshelter.com/docs/microgreens-for-ngos.html): a two-page offer of free seeds and videos for NGOs in Greece
- [A primer on food insecurity in south-western Uganda's refugee settlements](https://fromseedtoshelter.com/docs/uganda-food-insecurity-primer.html): our early understanding of the food situation in Nakivale, Kyaka II and Rwamwanja, including the "first-harvest gap" facing new arrivals, with references
- [Resources](https://fromseedtoshelter.com/resources.html): reports, the microgreens toolkit and instructional videos
- [About](https://fromseedtoshelter.com/about.html): team, partners and supporters
- [Contact](https://fromseedtoshelter.com/contact.html): how to partner with us, tell us about a gap, or support the work

## Documents

- [Samos pilot evaluation](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1HiKT7T0bPAehhOc65B_rPWRrqNN12Tmt/view): full evaluation of the Zervou Camp microgreens pilot — method, yields, costs, interview data and limitations
- [Microgreens toolkit](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1I5BwR0GalXsH7COrTW7j7N7vYf8COBq2/view): how to build and run a low-tech microgreens farm, written for NGOs and community organisations
- [Uganda primer (PDF)](https://drive.google.com/file/d/13O8BdGuw01oybl3d-oFw1I8pyFM2p9wB/view?usp=sharing): the primer above as a PDF
